newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka bourse suspends trade over security concern.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka bourse suspends trade over security concern.

text.p: Trading was suspended in the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) on Thursday as brokers and investors felt uneasy following clashes on Wednesday between kerb market operators and police, brokers said.
An official of the DSE said: "Brokers and their authorised assistants felt insecure, while the turnout of traders and investors was very thin."
The DSE all-share price index closed 2.73 percent down at 3,298.04 on a turnover of 166.4 million taka on Wednesday. Friday is the Moslem weekend and the market reopens on Saturday.
